title: 第12章 凭什么数值比男的还猛？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “吃饱了撑的。”

    方芸干净利落地拍掉手上的果屑，抄起地上的石斧，抬腿已经迈向了石门。

    许默拍了拍裤腿站起身。

    散布出去的蚂蚁正顺着岩缝接二连三地渗回来。

    方芸好奇的盯着看，但一直没开口问。

    成百上千只变异黑蚁在许默脚边汇聚，触角疯狂交错，海量的信息顺着精神丝线倒灌进他的脑海。

    许默闭目消化了片刻，随即在意识深处再次拉动蜂后。

    这丑东西，还是指望不上。

    他对蚁后下达命令。

    “带上你的蚁群，去周边搜刮一切能用的资源。避开体型超过半米的活物。”

    同时，许默打开酿造界面，添加狼血，水，种子。

    在尝试了二十多次之后。

    【叮——】

    【酿造成功：狼血酒】

    【效果：饮用后理智瞬间-10点，健康值-10。短期内攻击力+50%。】

    【附加状态：获得2小时“狼人”狂暴效果。激活需额外耗费20点理智，主动开启吸血技能，痛觉削弱70%，获得“洞察之眼”。】

    许默睁开眼，地上的黑蚁群再度如潮水般退去，替他酿酒过程打了个掩护。

    周围的情况已经存在脑海中，他抬头看向已经站在门边等候的方芸。

    “周围三公里内，正北方向有行踪非常明显的生物。”

    方芸掂了掂手里的石斧。

    “那咱们换条路，往北。碰碰运气搞点活肉。”

    许默抓起自己的战术手斧，大步跨出庇护所。

    方芸所在的位置，环境大不一样。

    这里是幽暗的原始丛林边缘，参天巨木遮天蔽日。

    许默选定了一棵碗口粗的常青树，双腿微曲，腰部猛然发力，战术手斧化作一道冷冽的银芒狠狠砸进树干。

    砰！

    木屑横飞。

    足足砍了十五分钟，沉闷的断裂声响彻林间。

    巨大的树冠轰然倒塌，砸起了一片惊鸟。

    他抬手抹去额头的热汗，掌心覆上粗糙的断木。

    【扫描完毕，收取：一阶木材*1】

    百步之外，方芸潜伏在暗处，双手紧握弓箭，警惕地环视着四周幽深的灌木丛。

    任何风吹草动都逃不过她的眼睛。

    许默弯下腰，用斧背拨开齐膝深的杂草。

    几株灰绿色、茎秆修长坚韧的植物映入眼帘。

    纤维草，搓绳子和制作防具的绝佳材料。

    他刚弯下腰准备采集。

    窸窸窣窣——

    右侧五米外的枯叶堆里，传来极其轻微的刮擦声。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

“I’m full after eating.”

Fang Yun neatly wiped off the fruit crumbs on her hands, picked up the stone ax on the ground, raised her legs and walked towards the stone door.

Xu Mo patted his trouser legs and stood up.

The ants that had spread out were seeping back one after another along the cracks in the rock.

Fang Yun stared curiously, but never asked.

Hundreds of mutated black ants gathered at Xu Mo's feet, their tentacles intertwined wildly, and a massive amount of information poured into his mind along the spiritual thread.

Xu Mo closed his eyes for a moment to digest, and then pulled the queen bee again deep in his consciousness.

"This ugly thing is still out of reach."

He gave orders to the queen ant.

"Take your ant colony with you and search the surrounding area for all available resources. Avoid living creatures over half a meter in size."

At the same time, Xu Mo opened the brewing interface and added wolf blood, water, and seeds.

After trying more than twenty times.

【Ding----】

【Brewing Successfully: Wolf Blood Wine】

【Effect: After drinking, the sanity is -10 points instantly and the health value is -10.Attack power +50% in the short term.】

【Additional status: Obtain the "Werewolf" violent effect for 2 hours.Activation requires an additional 20 points of sanity, actively activates blood-sucking skills, reduces pain by 70%, and obtains the "Eye of Insight".】

Xu Mo opened his eyes, and the black ant colony on the ground receded like a tide again, covering his brewing process.

The surrounding situation was already in his mind. He raised his head and looked at Fang Yun, who was already standing by the door waiting.

"Within three kilometers around, there are creatures with very obvious movements in the due north direction."

Fang Yun weighed the stone ax in her hand.

"Then let's change the road and go north. Try our luck to get some live meat."

Xu Mo grabbed his tactical ax and strode out of the shelter.

Where Fang Yun is, the environment is very different.

This is the edge of the dark primitive jungle, with towering trees blocking out the sky and the sun.

Xu Mo chose an evergreen tree as thick as a bowl. He bent his legs slightly and exerted force on his waist. The tactical ax turned into a cold silver light and slammed into the trunk of the tree.

Bang!

Sawdust flew everywhere.

After chopping for fifteen minutes, the dull cracking sound echoed through the forest.

The huge tree crown suddenly collapsed, shocking the birds.

He raised his hand to wipe the hot sweat from his forehead, and placed his palm on the rough broken wood.

[Scan completed, collected: first-level wood*1]

A hundred steps away, Fang Yun was lurking in the dark, holding a bow and arrow in both hands, looking around the deep bushes with vigilance.

No disturbance can escape her eyes.

Xu Mo bent down and used the back of an ax to push aside knee-deep weeds.

Several grey-green plants with slender and tough stems came into view.

Fiber grass is an excellent material for making ropes and armor.

He just bent down to collect.

Rustling rustling——

There was an extremely slight scraping sound coming from the pile of dead leaves five meters away on the right.
